_doc: What a question's layer-1 answers must reach before the app answers it (the questions stage; the gate never relaxes on its own). defaults apply to every question; questions.<name> overrides fields for one question (null removes the override). min_effective_train: the effective number of training examples, (Σw)²/Σw²; min_eval_labels: evaluation labels (the teacher sources with eval) a question needs to be measured at all; target_accuracy and z: the precision whose Wilson lower bound (at z) the answers given on their own must reach; family_wise: correct z for the number of questions tested (a two-sided Bonferroni bound, so the target is a family-wise statement; the report carries both the effective z and the base z); min_coverage: the share of the certification labels those answers must cover. The evaluation labels split by conversation (layer1.certify.fraction): the operating threshold is chosen on the selection part and tested once on the certification part, against the labels of certify_sources only (the teacher sources whose agreement is certified: a judge's labels certify agreement with the judge); the model that answers never trained on the certification part. request_labels: the evaluation labels the labels stage asks for per question (null: the fewest that can open the gate — the certification part must answer n labels without an error, n/n having a Wilson lower bound ≥ target_accuracy at z (381 at 0.99, z 1.96), on at least min_coverage of itself: ⌈n / (min_coverage × layer1.certify.fraction)⌉, at least min_eval_labels; 1,524 with the defaults). An answer whose confidence is below its question's certified threshold abstains and escalates. report_targets: the precision targets every report measures the coverage at. An override may reflect the question's wording (a low agreement ceiling), never one mailbox.
